bear_case.title: First criticality still isn't commercial power
bear_case.description: Oklo's Groves reactor achieving first criticality (Aug 2026) is real progress, but it's a small isotope test reactor, not a grid-connected commercial SMR. Zero advanced SMRs deliver commercial power anywhere; Clinch River — the furthest-along utility-scale application — still needs its Aug 13 mandatory hearing before a construction permit even issues, let alone gets built. First-of-a-kind builds historically run over budget and schedule (see Vogtle).

bear_case.title: A founding backer stepping back is a bigger tell than a press release
bear_case.description: Fluor has signaled plans to exit its NuScale stake in 2026 even as ENTRA1/TVA tout a non-binding 6 GW pathway and NuScale has already advanced a $495M milestone payment. When an early investor with inside knowledge of the technology reduces exposure, that carries more information than another non-binding MOU.

bear_case.title: Regulatory clearance still isn't construction, and construction still isn't power
bear_case.description: NRC's licensing-modernization rule (published Jul 16) remains in its comment period. TerraPower's Kemmerer permit was a genuine milestone — the first US approval of a commercial non-light-water reactor in 40+ years — yet the plant still won't generate power until roughly 2031. Multi-year gaps between permit and first power remain the norm across every design in this sector.

bear_case.title: Valuations are still pricing 2030s outcomes today
bear_case.description: Uranium spot ($86.48/lb) is well off the >$100 highs seen earlier this year despite term prices hitting a decade-high $94/lb. Pre-revenue names remain deeply loss-making — Oklo posted a $48.5M net loss on $1.2M of revenue, X-energy's Q1 loss deepened to $166.2M on $43.4M of revenue and grants — while trading on valuations that assume commercial success that hasn't happened yet.

catalysts.title: Oklo's Groves reactor achieves first criticality; Q2 earnings mixed
catalysts.description: First advanced SMR-class reactor to reach criticality, under a year after groundbreaking. Q2 revenue beat estimates ($1.21M vs $128K) but net loss widened to $48.5M (-$0.28/sh vs -$0.16 est.); shares jumped ~15% post-print on the milestone, still well below 2025 highs.

catalysts.title: Centrus posts profitable Q2, signs HALEU pact with X-energy
catalysts.description: Revenue $176.1M, GAAP net income $16.8M; contingent LEU/HALEU backlog grew to $3.0B. Signed a first-of-a-kind, large-scale commercial HALEU supply agreement with X-energy (deliveries from 2030) and selected Geiger Brothers to build out the Piketon expansion.

catalysts.title: BWXT beats and raises, sells medical business
catalysts.description: Fifth straight quarterly EPS beat; revenue +18% YoY to $901.6M, backlog +40% YoY. Raised FY2026 guidance to ~$3.8B revenue / $4.70-4.80 EPS and agreed to sell its medical business to Nordic Capital for up to $800M to sharpen its nuclear-components focus.

catalysts.title: NuScale/ENTRA1 6GW pathway advances — but Fluor signals an exit
catalysts.description: ENTRA1 Energy's 6GW SMR pathway with TVA gained traction (still non-binding; $495M milestone payment already made), even as founding backer Fluor signaled plans to exit its NuScale equity stake during 2026.

catalysts.title: Commonwealth Fusion raises another $1B
catalysts.description: Brings total capital raised to roughly $4B from pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and strategic industrial investors; funds construction of the SPARC demonstration machine in Devens, MA, now reported ~80% complete.

catalysts.title: Clinch River mandatory NRC hearing; X-energy Q2 earnings (upcoming)
catalysts.description: NRC's mandatory uncontested hearing on TVA's Clinch River BWRX-300 construction permit convenes 5:30pm in Oak Ridge, TN — the final step before a first-of-its-kind SMR construction permit could issue. X-energy also reports Q2 results the same morning.

positions.name: BWX Technologies

positions.name: Centrus Energy

positions.name: Oklo
positions.note: Groves reactor hit first criticality Aug 7 — the first advanced SMR-class reactor to do so — but net loss still widened to $48.5M on essentially no revenue. Real technical progress; still nowhere near commercial power.

positions.name: NuScale Power
positions.note: Fluor signaling plans to exit its NuScale stake in 2026 is a bigger tell than the non-binding ENTRA1/TVA 6GW pathway is a positive — a founding backer de-risking outweighs another MOU.

positions.name: X-energy
positions.note: New Centrus HALEU pact and Amazon backing are real, but Q1 net loss deepened to $166.2M on just $43.4M of revenue and grants; the Aug 13 Q2 print is the next real test before this earns a position.
